correctness.rationale: PASS. For U,V joint centered normal with variance q and correlation r, cos-cos and sin-sin covariance identities yield C=(1-z)^2/2+z(cosh(qr)-1), S=(1-z^2)/2+z sinh(qr), z=e^-q. Reflection kills cross cosine-sine covariance, so maximum over arbitrary phi of Var[(cos(U+phi)+cos(V+phi))/2] is max(C,S)/2. On [-1,0], C strictly decreasing and S strictly increasing in r, with C(-1)>S(-1), C(0)<S(0); their unique intersection e^(-qr)=2-z yields r*=-log(2-z)/q strictly in (-1,0). On (0,1] S exceeds the zero-correlation maximum, proving global uniqueness. Substitution gives (1-z)^2/(2(2-z)), and endpoint comparisons/limits follow from elementary inequalities and Taylor series. Independently expanded characteristic functions and re-expressed hyperbolic terms in exponentials for symbolic equality checks; finite quadrature claims in the package are corroborative only.
